title: Electric Crab — Multi-Agent Prediction Market System
description: Contributed to the development and testing of Electric Crab, a multi-agent prediction market system integrating AI agents for market analysis, forecasting, and collaborative decision-making.
highlights: Participated in the development and testing of eight AI agents, including price analysis and sentiment analysis components.
Supported agent functionality testing, system debugging, and scenario validation for abnormal market movements.
Identified potential risks associated with market manipulation and proposed improvements to the system's risk-warning logic.
Used Claude Code and Codex to support code review, test-case generation, and project delivery.

title: Decentralized AI Agent Interoperability
role: Project Team Member · Global AI Conference & Hackathon Tokyo
description: Worked on an open-source interoperability framework for decentralized AI agents, exploring communication, coordination, identity verification, and context sharing across autonomous agents.
highlights: Contributed to an agent-to-agent communication framework building on concepts from Google's A2A protocol.
Explored decentralized identity, authorization, and security verification mechanisms for agent interactions.
Worked on collaboration patterns involving division of labor, relay, supervision, and shared context.
Investigated coordination challenges in distributed multi-agent environments.

title: Generative AI for Banking Data Analysis
description: Investigated generative artificial intelligence approaches for banking data analysis, synthetic data generation, and predictive modeling using historical financial information.
highlights: Collected and preprocessed historical banking datasets through cleaning, transformation, and normalization.
Explored generative adversarial networks and Transformer-based encoder-decoder architectures.
Worked on model training and the generation of synthetic data samples.
Investigated financial trend analysis using generated data, market conditions, and economic indicators.

title: Machine Learning for Quantitative Strategy Research
description: Explored machine learning approaches for quantitative investment research, including market data processing, predictive modeling, alpha factor exploration, and research model reproduction.
highlights: Performed financial data cleaning and feature engineering to support quantitative model development.
Explored machine learning and deep learning methods for identifying predictive market signals.
Studied and reproduced research methods from machine learning and quantitative finance literature.
Investigated the applicability of selected models to financial market data.

title: Generative AI Model Building — Budweiser China Challenge
description: Participated in a generative AI modeling project for marketing-related data as part of the Budweiser China Data Technology and Analytics Challenge, winning first place in the competition track.
highlights: Performed dataset preparation, cleaning, deduplication, and tokenization.
Worked with sequence modeling, attention mechanisms, and generative adversarial modeling approaches.
Conducted model experimentation and parameter adjustment to improve generation quality.
Used Docker to package applications and their dependencies for consistent execution.
